paragraphs: Hi, I’m Zakaria Fattawari, a third-year Computer Science student at Kalimantan Institute of Technology, commonly known as ITK. I mostly enjoy building web projects, trying out game ideas, and occasionally getting lost in machine learning stuff. I’m still figuring out what I want to focus on the most, but I like learning by making things.

Most of my time goes into turning random ideas, campus assignments, or personal experiments into actual projects. I enjoy working on websites, designing interfaces, writing features, and figuring out why something suddenly does not work at 2 AM. I also like seeing a project slowly come together, even when the process is a little painful.

I did not come from a strong technical background, so a lot of my journey has been about learning things from scratch and being okay with not understanding everything immediately. Right now, I’m trying to get better at databases, APIs, full-stack development, system design, and writing code that is not held together by hope and console logs.

Outside of coding, I’m also involved as a Guider or Pemandu in LKMM ITK, where I get to work with other students and help with leadership and organizational activities. It has taught me a lot about communication, teamwork, and handling responsibilities things that are just as useful as technical skills when working on real projects.

about.quote: And after all that anger, violence and death, you have to dig deep into your own heart to see if you're still sane, or if you can still call yourself: a human. I just knew in my heart that I wasn't that crazy.
